subject: Interim prorate for added seats — HydraCorp billing split
messages:
From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@hydracorp.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@hydracorp.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Mid-cycle seats added — need prorate breakdown & EU invoice split

Hi Nikhil / Sean,

We added 12 seats to our Dedicated pool on 2026-05-15 (original commitment: 50 seats on a monthly billing cadence). Our internal finance team needs: 1) a line-item prorated charge for the 12-seat add (dates + per-seat rate + pro-rata factor), 2) confirmation whether Redwood can split the charge across our US parent (HydraCorp, EIN: 12-3456789) and our EU subsidiary (HydraCorp EU, VAT: pending) — the EU entity needs a separate invoice so they can apply reverse-charge.

Also confirm whether you applied VAT to the provisional charge or left it net so we can apply reverse charge.

Can you provide a provisional invoice and the proration calculation so we can route to accounting? We need this before our month-end close on 2026-05-27.

Thanks,
Elena
Finance Manager
HydraCorp

--
Attachment: none (requesting docs)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@hydracorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seats added — need prorate breakdown & EU invoice split

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and heads-up on the close date. We're on it. Quick answers up-front:
- Yes, we can produce a provisional prorated invoice showing the mid-cycle seat add as a separate line.
- We can split the charge across two invoices (US parent + EU subsidiary) but we need the EU VAT number and the exact legal entity name for the EU invoice.
- For reverse-charge: we will leave the EU invoice net (0% VAT) if you confirm the VAT ID and that reverse-charge applies; otherwise we'll apply the standard VAT until you provide the VAT ID and instructions.

I'll loop in Marissa from billing to generate the detailed calc and provisional invoice (she will attach an XLSX with the math and a provisional PDF). Expect that in ~1 business day. If you need a docuSign amendment for procurement to reflect the seat increase, say so and we will attach the link in the follow-up.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Exec, North America
Redwood Inference

--
Replying inline:
> we added 12 seats on 2026-05-15
Confirmed — we'll prorate from 2026-05-15 through the remainder of your billing cycle (May 15–31).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@hydracorp.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seats added — provisional invoice & proration calc attached

Hi Elena — attaching the requested materials. Summary below and notes on VAT handling.

Attachments: proration_calc_20260523.xlsx; provisional_invoice_20260523.pdf

Summary proration (for visibility):
- Existing committed seats: 50 seats (monthly rate per seat: $210.00)
- Add-on: 12 seats added 2026-05-15
- Billing cycle: calendar month (May 1–31)
- Days charged for add: 17 days (May 15–31 inclusive) / 31 days in May = 17/31 = 0.548387

Calculation (per-seat): $210.00 * (17/31) = $115.16 per seat for remainder of May
12 seats * $115.16 = $1,381.92 (net)

Tax/VAT handling notes:
- Because you asked for an EU-split invoice we prepared two provisional PDFs: one net invoice for HydraCorp EU (line items net; VAT field blank) and one for HydraCorp US (standard US billing). We will only apply VAT if you instruct us to or if we do not receive a valid EU VAT number prior to final invoicing.
- If HydraCorp EU confirms the VAT ID and reverse-charge applies, your EU invoice will show zero VAT and a note referencing reverse-charge.

Next steps we need from your side (to finalize and send):
1) Confirm the legal entity name + VAT ID for HydraCorp EU (exact string to appear on invoice).
2) Confirm which entity should be charged in May (if you want us to bill the entire prorate to the US parent and have you internally allocate, say so).
3) If you want a signed amendment for procurement, confirm signatories and we'll generate a DocuSign link.

I've also included an amortized schedule in the XLSX (shows the monthly impact if seats remain +12 next month). If you want the proration split across multiple invoices instead of two invoices, note that in your reply and we'll revise.

Thanks — will pause final invoice until we have your entity/VAT confirmation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: proration_calc_20260523.xlsx (spreadsheet with line-by-line math); provisional_invoice_20260523.pdf (two provisional PDFs embedded: HydraCorp_US.pdf, HydraCorp_EU_net.pdf)

From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@hydracorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@hydracorp.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seats added — provisional invoice & proration calc attached

Thanks Marissa — the calc looks good and the split approach works for us. A couple items from finance:

1) HydraCorp EU legal name: HydraCorp Europe B.V.
   VAT ID: NL999999999B01
2) Please leave the EU invoice net and include a note: "Reverse-charge mechanism applies per EU VAT rules; recipient to account for VAT."
3) We would prefer the prorate billed on a single consolidated Redwood invoice that contains two sections (US-charged lines + EU-net lines) rather than two separate invoices. That makes our AP matching easier. Can you do that?

We also need a DocuSign amendment so procurement can sign the seat increase. Can you generate it for signatory: Marco DiStefano (Procurement Director) AND CC finance@hydracorp.com? Marco's email: marco.distefano@hydracorp.com.

If you can get the consolidated provisional invoice + DocuSign link by 2026-05-23 EOD PT that would be perfect for our close.

Best,
Elena

--
Note: HydraCorp EU VAT ID provided above.

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@hydracorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marco DiStefano <marco.distefano@hydracorp.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seats added — final provisional invoice + DocuSign link

Hi Elena — thanks for the prompt turnaround and for the VAT details. Per your preference we've produced: 1) a consolidated provisional invoice PDF with two sections (HydraCorp US — standard billing; HydraCorp Europe B.V. — net, reverse-charge note), and 2) an XLSX with the per-seat math. Both are attached.

We've also created the DocuSign amendment for the seat increase and set Marco DiStefano as the primary signer, finance@hydracorp.com as CC. Link attached in a tiny text file (amendment_docusign_link.txt). Once Marco signs, we'll finalize the invoice and post it to your billing portal.

Recap of the prorated charge for May (for internal audit):
- 12 seats added on 2026-05-15
- Per-seat monthly list price: $210.00
- Pro-rate factor (May): 17/31 = 0.548387
- Per-seat prorated amount: $115.16
- Line total (12 seats): $1,381.92 (net)
- Consolidated invoice will show USD amounts; EU section will be net with the reverse-charge note.

If everything looks good please confirm and we'll send the finalized invoice after DocuSign completion.

Link: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/Amendment-2026-1582 (also included in amendment_docusign_link.txt)

Thanks — and let us know if you want the prorate split across separate monthly accrual lines for your internal GL.

Best regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Exec, North America
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments included: proration_calc_20260523.xlsx, provisional_invoice_20260523.pdf, amendment_docusign_link.txt
